transcription.title: Step 1: Select a File
transcription.text: Welcome to AutoVerse! To start, click the highlighted 'Browse' button to select an audio or video file you want to transcribe.

transcription.title: Step 2: Choose a Model
transcription.text: Now, choose the transcription model. The 'large' model is the most accurate and is already selected for you. You can change it if needed, or click Next to continue.

transcription.title: Step 3: Identify Speakers
transcription.text: If your audio has multiple speakers, check this box. This will automatically label who is speaking (e.g., SPEAKER_00, SPEAKER_01).

transcription.title: Step 4: Include Timestamps
transcription.text: It's highly recommended to include timestamps. This makes your transcript much easier to review and edit later. Ensure this box is checked.

transcription.title: Step 5: Continue
transcription.text: Great! All the main options are set. Click the 'Continue to Processing' button to move to the final step.

transcription.title: Step 6: Start Processing
transcription.text: You're all set! Click 'Start Processing' to begin. The tutorial will hide while processing and reappear when it's finished.

transcription.title: Step 7: View Your Transcript
transcription.text: Congratulations! Your transcript appears here. The final step is to move to the Correction tab for advanced editing.

transcription.title: Step 8: Head to Correction
transcription.text: Click the 'Head to correction tab' button to open this transcript in the advanced editor. This will end the tutorial.
